raw: [Decision(options="You've been humming that song ever since we stepped into the throne room.;Do you like it?", values="1;2")]
options: You've been humming that song ever since we stepped into the throne room.;Do you like it?

raw: [name="Vina"]'Like' is too strong a word. It's just left an impression on me.
speaker: Vina
content: 'Like' is too strong a word. It's just left an impression on me.

raw: [name="Vina"]My foster parents would hum it by my bedside whenever I couldn't sleep.
speaker: Vina
content: My foster parents would hum it by my bedside whenever I couldn't sleep.

raw: [name="Vina"]I thought it was a lullaby. It's only long after they've passed on that I realized whom I was to them, who was their 'kynge'.
speaker: Vina
content: I thought it was a lullaby. It's only long after they've passed on that I realized whom I was to them, who was their 'kynge'.

raw: [name="Vina"]The song became a stranger from that day forth, but the tune has remained familiar. I would never forget it.
speaker: Vina
content: The song became a stranger from that day forth, but the tune has remained familiar. I would never forget it.

options: Do you still remember him? The...

raw: [name="Vina"]The King? I'm not familiar with him. As for the man who is my closest blood relative...
speaker: Vina
content: The King? I'm not familiar with him. As for the man who is my closest blood relative...

raw: [name="Vina"]I won't lie, Doctor, I tried to piece together an image of my father in my memory.
speaker: Vina
content: I won't lie, Doctor, I tried to piece together an image of my father in my memory.

raw: [name="Vina"]But when I saw him again with my own eyes, there was nothing familiar about him.
speaker: Vina
content: But when I saw him again with my own eyes, there was nothing familiar about him.

raw: [name="Vina"]He was a king, and I'm just a gangster from the streets. We have nothing in common, save for the name Victoria.
speaker: Vina
content: He was a king, and I'm just a gangster from the streets. We have nothing in common, save for the name Victoria.

raw: [name="Vina"]There are more important things for me to think about.
speaker: Vina
content: There are more important things for me to think about.

raw: [name="Vina"]You heard the dukes talking. They're ready to abandon Londinium... my home, to whatever fate.
speaker: Vina
content: You heard the dukes talking. They're ready to abandon Londinium... my home, to whatever fate.

raw: [name="Vina"]This wasn't what I expected when Dr. Kal'tsit got you out of Chernobog and got me to plan a return to Victoria.
speaker: Vina
content: This wasn't what I expected when Dr. Kal'tsit got you out of Chernobog and got me to plan a return to Victoria.

raw: [name="Vina"]But I've come too far to let it go.
speaker: Vina
content: But I've come too far to let it go.

raw: [Decision(options="Responsibility is a curious thing.;I can't let go of the Rhodes Islanders, either.;We're the same.", values="1;2;3")]
options: Responsibility is a curious thing.;I can't let go of the Rhodes Islanders, either.;We're the same.

raw: [Decision(options="The dukes know you can't let go of the people who need you. They're counting on it.",values="1")]
options: The dukes know you can't let go of the people who need you. They're counting on it.

raw: [name="Vina"]And we're counting on them being obsessed with maintaining their own power.
speaker: Vina
content: And we're counting on them being obsessed with maintaining their own power.

raw: [name="Vina"]As long as their pride still needs the name 'Victoria', the city will have time to recover.
speaker: Vina
content: As long as their pride still needs the name 'Victoria', the city will have time to recover.

raw: [name="Vina"]It's a deal where the outcome is predetermined, and both sides of the table know that.
speaker: Vina
content: It's a deal where the outcome is predetermined, and both sides of the table know that.

raw: [name="Vina"]It's the people who have had my back through all this that keeps me going.
speaker: Vina
content: It's the people who have had my back through all this that keeps me going.

raw: [name="Vina"]We're home. The war is over. It's time to listen to their voices.
speaker: Vina
content: We're home. The war is over. It's time to listen to their voices.

speaker: Vina
content: What is it, Doctor?

raw: [Decision(options="Perhaps the day will come when Rhodes Island doesn't approve of the choices you make.;Perhaps the day will come when you don't approve of the choices Rhodes Island makes.", values="1;2")]
options: Perhaps the day will come when Rhodes Island doesn't approve of the choices you make.;Perhaps the day will come when you don't approve of the choices Rhodes Island makes.

speaker: Vina
content: ...I know.

raw: [name="Vina"]Many of us find it hard to accept that you assisted Wiš'adel with the evacuation of the remaining Sarkaz.
speaker: Vina
content: Many of us find it hard to accept that you assisted Wiš'adel with the evacuation of the remaining Sarkaz.

raw: [name="Vina"]But this war can go on no longer. I... We've lost enough people.
speaker: Vina
content: But this war can go on no longer. I... We've lost enough people.

raw: [name="Vina"]And we've heard Sarkaz warning, loud and clear.
speaker: Vina
content: And we've heard Sarkaz warning, loud and clear.

raw: [name="Vina"]The ducal fleets held their positions during the retreat because they all got the news—
speaker: Vina
content: The ducal fleets held their positions during the retreat because they all got the news—

raw: [name="Vina"]Massive Catastrophe clouds forming over the capitals of most of the Core countries almost simultaneously.
speaker: Vina
content: Massive Catastrophe clouds forming over the capitals of most of the Core countries almost simultaneously.

raw: [name="Vina"]Talk about straightforward. They strolled back to Kazdel in broad daylight.
speaker: Vina
content: Talk about straightforward. They strolled back to Kazdel in broad daylight.

raw: [name="Vina"]You and Dr. Kal'tsit know what they could do with that piece of Originium.
speaker: Vina
content: You and Dr. Kal'tsit know what they could do with that piece of Originium.

raw: [Decision(options="They won't abuse it, unless their back is to the wall.",values="1")]
options: They won't abuse it, unless their back is to the wall.

raw: [name="Vina"]For self-defense only? Maybe they think that way, for now.
speaker: Vina
content: For self-defense only? Maybe they think that way, for now.

raw: [name="Vina"]But there is no such thing as a guarantee when one is in possession of power far greater than one can control.
speaker: Vina
content: But there is no such thing as a guarantee when one is in possession of power far greater than one can control.

raw: [name="Vina"]I've seen many gangs rise rapidly with the backing of the nobility, only to fall apart from the inside just as quickly.
speaker: Vina
content: I've seen many gangs rise rapidly with the backing of the nobility, only to fall apart from the inside just as quickly.

raw: [Decision(options="That's why Amiya is going back to Kazdel with them.;Amiya will keep the Originium under our oversight.", values="1;2")]
options: That's why Amiya is going back to Kazdel with them.;Amiya will keep the Originium under our oversight.

speaker: Delphine
content: What is this instrument, Vina?

raw: [name="Vina"]An engineering sample made by Rockrock. Says it keeps tired workers from growing drowsy. But how's that different from just taking a nap?
speaker: Vina
content: An engineering sample made by Rockrock. Says it keeps tired workers from growing drowsy. But how's that different from just taking a nap?

speaker: Delphine
content: Does it work?

raw: Vina yawns, rubs her eyes, and continues to peruse the documents before her.
content: Vina yawns, rubs her eyes, and continues to peruse the documents before her.

speaker: Vina
content: No.

raw: [name="Vina"]What DOES wake you up, though, is responding to some forty petitions to eliminate the traitor, Millscar.
speaker: Vina
content: What DOES wake you up, though, is responding to some forty petitions to eliminate the traitor, Millscar.

raw: [name="Vina"]Have the citizens fighting over this outside calmed down?
speaker: Vina
content: Have the citizens fighting over this outside calmed down?

raw: [name="Delphine"]Yes. Horn brought a bunch of city guard's newcomers straight out of training camp.
speaker: Delphine
content: Yes. Horn brought a bunch of city guard's newcomers straight out of training camp.

raw: [name="Vina"]Thank goodness it didn't get out of hand.
speaker: Vina
content: Thank goodness it didn't get out of hand.

raw: [name="Delphine"]It helped that the soldiers had families and comrades on both sides. *sigh* I really don't know what the people who still support Millscar are thinking.
speaker: Delphine
content: It helped that the soldiers had families and comrades on both sides. *sigh* I really don't know what the people who still support Millscar are thinking.

raw: [name="Vina"]No surprise. It was Parliament that went back on its word first. We did have trouble with our medicine supply, and her stuff gave people hope.
speaker: Vina
content: No surprise. It was Parliament that went back on its word first. We did have trouble with our medicine supply, and her stuff gave people hope.

speaker: Delphine
content: Only false hope, though.

raw: [name="Delphine"]At first, I thought you sent the Defense Forces to...
speaker: Delphine
content: At first, I thought you sent the Defense Forces to...

raw: [name="Vina"]Crack down? Using violence to suppress innocent countrymen is the most cowardly and least effective method—
speaker: Vina
content: Crack down? Using violence to suppress innocent countrymen is the most cowardly and least effective method—

raw: [name="Vina"]Why are you looking at me like that?
speaker: Vina
content: Why are you looking at me like that?

raw: [name="Delphine"]Just feeling dumb for worrying at all.
speaker: Delphine
content: Just feeling dumb for worrying at all.

raw: [name="Vina"]Don't tease me. I've got a long way to go before I'm used to this role. Thank goodness I have a lot help from people I can trust.
speaker: Vina
content: Don't tease me. I've got a long way to go before I'm used to this role. Thank goodness I have a lot help from people I can trust.

raw: [name="Vina"]My teacher, the Doctor, and you... and many others.
speaker: Vina
content: My teacher, the Doctor, and you... and many others.

raw: She stretches, puts down Rockrock's sample, and lets out a long exhalation.
content: She stretches, puts down Rockrock's sample, and lets out a long exhalation.

raw: [name="Vina"]I would be stumbling in the dark without the intel from your informants and our Rhodes Island colleagues.
speaker: Vina
content: I would be stumbling in the dark without the intel from your informants and our Rhodes Island colleagues.

speaker: Delphine
content: But Millscar...

raw: [name="Vina"]Selling dangerous drugs of unknown origin, offering predatory loans, threatening the lives of the citizenry... and colluding with the Sarkaz...
speaker: Vina
content: Selling dangerous drugs of unknown origin, offering predatory loans, threatening the lives of the citizenry... and colluding with the Sarkaz...

raw: [name="Vina"]All the evidence lies in my drawer, all of it corroborated. She cannot be allowed to run unchecked just because some few benefited from association with her.
speaker: Vina
content: All the evidence lies in my drawer, all of it corroborated. She cannot be allowed to run unchecked just because some few benefited from association with her.

speaker: Delphine
content: Allerdale, she—

speaker: Vina
content: It's not just her, Delphine.

raw: [name="Vina"]No one wants to see this hard-earned peace broken again, after all we've been through.
speaker: Vina
content: No one wants to see this hard-earned peace broken again, after all we've been through.

raw: [name="Vina"]Parliament promised safety to the people. I know what must be done.
speaker: Vina
content: Parliament promised safety to the people. I know what must be done.

raw: [name="Delphine"]Very well. An old friend has a lead on her that might interest you.
speaker: Delphine
content: Very well. An old friend has a lead on her that might interest you.

raw: [name="Delphine"]By the way, I've given serious consideration to the Doctor's suggestion.
speaker: Delphine
content: By the way, I've given serious consideration to the Doctor's suggestion.

raw: [name="Delphine"]Once things have settled down for a bit, I'll return to Windermere and take back certain things that have always belonged to me.
speaker: Delphine
content: Once things have settled down for a bit, I'll return to Windermere and take back certain things that have always belonged to me.

speaker: Vina
content: How long will you be?

raw: [name="Delphine"]I don't know. But the Doctor is right. I need what Mother left behind, if I am to help you... even if I was reluctant at the time of her death.
speaker: Delphine
content: I don't know. But the Doctor is right. I need what Mother left behind, if I am to help you... even if I was reluctant at the time of her death.

speaker: Vina
content: Thank you.

raw: [name="Delphine"]It's for myself, too. Victoria, Windermere, Lynncardine... I must see for myself that which Mother cared so much about.
speaker: Delphine
content: It's for myself, too. Victoria, Windermere, Lynncardine... I must see for myself that which Mother cared so much about.

raw: [name="Delphine"]It's the only way I can get closer to her.
speaker: Delphine
content: It's the only way I can get closer to her.

raw: [name="Injured Exemplar"]Sir! Please allow me to still call you that... I-I didn't think you would come to me.
speaker: Injured Exemplar
content: Sir! Please allow me to still call you that... I-I didn't think you would come to me.

speaker: Injured Exemplar
content: Did my application go through?

raw: [name="Horn"]Walker, I've heard how Pitt and the others got you to leave the scene of the protest. I think—
speaker: Horn
content: Walker, I've heard how Pitt and the others got you to leave the scene of the protest. I think—

raw: [name="Walker"]So that's not what you're here for... Alright. Actually, I've been listening to the radio, sir.
speaker: Walker
content: So that's not what you're here for... Alright. Actually, I've been listening to the radio, sir.

raw: [name="Walker"]I heard about the artillery handover to the newly reorganized Defense Forces under your command, and the newly-constructed training plate outside the city.
speaker: Walker
content: I heard about the artillery handover to the newly reorganized Defense Forces under your command, and the newly-constructed training plate outside the city.

raw: [name="Walker"]I went to see it myself. The facilities are superb. I can even imagine myself training there...
speaker: Walker
content: I went to see it myself. The facilities are superb. I can even imagine myself training there...

raw: [name="Horn"]I'm sorry, Walker, but I can't approve your application to join the Defense Forces.
speaker: Horn
content: I'm sorry, Walker, but I can't approve your application to join the Defense Forces.

raw: [name="Walker"]Sure, if I'm not up to standard, I'll redouble my—
speaker: Walker
content: Sure, if I'm not up to standard, I'll redouble my—

raw: [name="Horn"]You know your own health. Training and fighting will only make it worse.
speaker: Horn
content: You know your own health. Training and fighting will only make it worse.

raw: [name="Walker"]My condition is under control. I'm taking medicine. I haven't felt any pain from the rocks for a while! I'm getting better—
speaker: Walker
content: My condition is under control. I'm taking medicine. I haven't felt any pain from the rocks for a while! I'm getting better—

raw: [name="Horn"]Millscar's medicine, right? We've analyzed it, and it's...
speaker: Horn
content: Millscar's medicine, right? We've analyzed it, and it's...

raw: [name="Walker"]Nothing more than a painkiller. I know.
speaker: Walker
content: Nothing more than a painkiller. I know.

raw: [name="Walker"]But that's what we need. Parliament's medicine rations are running out, aren't they?
speaker: Walker
content: But that's what we need. Parliament's medicine rations are running out, aren't they?

raw: [name="Walker"]At least this makes me feel better, for a while, and lets me practice wielding a crossbow with one hand. I'll pass the Defense Forces tests, sir.
speaker: Walker
content: At least this makes me feel better, for a while, and lets me practice wielding a crossbow with one hand. I'll pass the Defense Forces tests, sir.

raw: [name="Walker"]'There will be hope as long as we make it back home, no matter how bloody goddamned hard life is.' That's what you told me during the defense of Chetleigh.
speaker: Walker
content: 'There will be hope as long as we make it back home, no matter how bloody goddamned hard life is.' That's what you told me during the defense of Chetleigh.
